meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: Claude 会通过提问了解你的工作,然后为 claude-mem 设计一套专属“模式”(含互斥的笔记分类和通用标签),经你批准后安装为当前模式;如需要会配置 Telegram 提醒,最后重启并验证新模式在启动信息中生效。
howto.when: 当你想定制 claude-mem 记住什么、创建或修改笔记模式,或为某类笔记设置 Telegram 通知等需求时触发——哪怕你没说“mode”。

say.text: 我是律师,想记录判例建立的规则和考试陷阱
say.note: Claude 先提问了解工作,再提分类方案让你确认

say.text: 我是建筑师,想记录设计决策、场地发现和客户偏好
say.note: 批准分类后才安装,并会询问是否要 Telegram 提醒

say.text: 加个模式记录线上事故,出事时发 Telegram 通知
say.note: Telegram 只在同意后配置,不会要求把令牌贴进对话

howto.what_en: Claude interviews the user about their work, designs a custom claude-mem mode (mutually exclusive observation types plus reusable concept tags), installs and activates it after approval, optionally configures Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and verifies the new mode appears in startup context.
howto.when_en: Activated when someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, or get Telegram notifications for particular memories, even if they do not say "mode."

say_en.text: I'm a lawyer; log rules established by cases and exam traps my professor highlights.
say_en.note: Claude interviews about your work before proposing a taxonomy.

say_en.text: I'm an architect; capture design decisions, site discoveries, and client preferences.
say_en.note: Approval is required before install; alerts are optional.

say_en.text: Add a mode that logs production incidents and sends a Telegram alert for each one.
say_en.note: Telegram setup is interactive and never asks for the token in chat.
